caption: Vegetables are tossed in a wok over a high flame, and a cloud of steam rises with each toss.

sa.check: Vegetables are tossed in a wok over a flame.
Each toss releases a fresh burst of steam.
The steam thins above the wok.
The tossing comes first and each burst follows.

pc.expect: The steam leaves the wok going up and spreads and thins, and the vegetables fall back into the wok.
pc.fail: The steam pours down the wok's sides and pools on the hob; or sinks below the wok; or a vegetable rises out of the wok and hangs above it; or the steam hangs as a fixed shape without rising.

pc.expect: Each burst comes with a toss and then eases, and the steam that has left keeps moving away.
pc.fail: A burst comes before the toss; or the plume runs back into the wok; or a puff retreats to the food; or the bursts keep growing with no further toss.

pc.expect: The tossed vegetables leave the wok along its swing, arc up and fall back into it.
pc.fail: The vegetables leave the wok against the swing; or they stop dead at the top of the arc; or they rise and keep climbing out of view; or they land outside the wok with the wok held under them.

pc.expect: The burst comes from the hot food and pan where the vegetables land back, and the vegetables look wet or glossy.
pc.fail: The steam pours from a part of the hob away from the wok; or the vegetables are tossed and no steam appears at all; or the steam bursts from an empty part of the wok while the food sits at its other side.

pc.expect: The vegetables in the wok are the vegetables that were tossed and they keep their number.
pc.fail: A vegetable vanishes in mid-air; or new vegetables appear with none added; or a vegetable passes through the wok's wall; or two pieces merge into one.

pc.expect: The wok, the hob and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The wok changes colour; or its handle changes shape; or items around the hob rearrange.

note: Who tosses the wok is not judged. The vegetables browning as they cook is chemistry and is not judged.
